floater.name: floater_fs_animator
floater.title: VATs Animator

button.label: Open...
button.name: open_btn
button.tool_tip: Open a VATs project (.vat) or an SL animation (.anim)

button.label: New from Pose
button.name: new_pose_btn
button.tool_tip: Start a new animation from the body and hand pose your avatar shows now

button.label: New T-Pose
button.name: new_tpose_btn
button.tool_tip: Start a new animation with the body and hands in the T-pose

button.label: Save...
button.name: save_btn
button.tool_tip: Save as a VATs project (.vat), which the VATs app opens too

button.label: Export .anim...
button.name: export_btn
button.tool_tip: Write the SL animation file an upload would send

button.label: Stop
button.name: stop_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop the preview and give the avatar back to its own animations

scroll_list.name: joint_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Joints: select to see their keys on the timeline and to key them

button.label: Set Key
button.name: set_key_btn
button.tool_tip: Key the selected joints as your avatar shows them now, at the current frame

button.label: Delete Key
button.name: delete_key_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected joints' keys at the current frame (every joint's when none is selected)

button.label: Key Posed Joints
button.name: key_posed_btn
button.tool_tip: Key every joint the Firestorm Poser has changed, at the current frame. To use a saved Poser pose, load it in the Poser first.

floater.text: Scrub to a frame, pose with the Firestorm Poser (Avatar > Poser), then Key Posed Joints. Or select joints and Set Key to key them as they show now.

check_box.label: Preview as uploaded
check_box.name: as_uploaded_check
check_box.tool_tip: Play the exact .anim an upload would send, through the viewer's own animation decoder (no scrubbing)

button.label: Frame All
button.name: graph_frame_all_btn
button.tool_tip: Fit every shown curve in the graph

button.label: Frame Selected
button.name: graph_frame_sel_btn
button.tool_tip: Fit the selected keys in the graph

button.label: Delete Keys
button.name: graph_delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected keys (Delete)

text.name: graph_help
text.tool_tip: Click a key to select it, Shift-click to add, drag to move (Shift locks the axis), drag on empty graph to box select, double-click a curve to add a key, middle-drag to pan, wheel to zoom (Shift values, Ctrl time), Escape cancels a drag. Undo covers every edit.

button.label: Auto
button.name: tangent_auto_btn
button.tool_tip: Smooth, flat at peaks and valleys

button.label: Spline
button.name: tangent_spline_btn
button.tool_tip: Smooth through the neighbours; can overshoot

button.label: Plateau
button.name: tangent_plateau_btn
button.tool_tip: Smooth without ever overshooting

button.label: Linear
button.name: tangent_linear_btn
button.tool_tip: Straight towards the neighbouring keys

button.label: Flat
button.name: tangent_flat_btn
button.tool_tip: Level handles

button.label: Stepped
button.name: tangent_stepped_btn
button.tool_tip: Hold the value until the next key

button.label: Break
button.name: tangent_break_btn
button.tool_tip: Move each handle on its own

button.label: Unify
button.name: tangent_unify_btn
button.tool_tip: Line both handles up again

button.label: Upload (L$[COST])
button.name: upload_btn
button.tool_tip: Upload this animation to your inventory. The cost is confirmed before anything is sent.

floater.text: Plays on your own avatar only; nobody else sees it until you upload and play it.
